theme_central: Establishing Tawhid in absolute terms and refuting polytheism from every angle — theological, rational, cosmological, historical (Ibrahim) and legislative.
sources_note: General themes confirmed (islamicstudies.info via alim.org: refutation of shirk, the afterlife, refutation of superstitions, moral principles, response to objections). The precise verse boundaries could NOT be cross-checked with a dedicated online source — reconstructed from widely taught landmarks (Ibrahim v.74-83, the "10 precepts" v.151-153). To be verified verse by verse before production use.

branches.resume: Allah the Creator and All-Knowing, mockery of the signs, warning to the disbelievers.

Allah's omniscience, an anticipated scene of the Day of Judgment

Not turning away the poor believers, the parable of the blind and the seeing

branches.title: Ibrahim and the line of prophets
branches.resume: Ibrahim contemplates the heavenly bodies and breaks with his people's polytheism.
